title: Rydex — Vehicle Rental & Ride Booking Platform
tagline: Geospatial marketplace with booking orchestration and partner onboarding
description: Built a comprehensive vehicle rental and ride-booking platform supporting vehicle discovery, bookings, partner onboarding, payments with commission calculations, identity verification, real-time tracking, and communication.
problem: Vehicle rental and ride-booking marketplaces require complex orchestration: users need to discover nearby vehicles, partners need onboarding and verification, bookings need payment and commission handling, rides need real-time tracking, and all parties need secure communication.
solution: Built a full-stack Next.js marketplace with geospatial vehicle discovery using GeoJSON, eight-step partner onboarding with video KYC, automated commission calculations, real-time ride tracking, OTP-based confirmations, and AI-powered messaging.

bookingLifecycle.description: User enters location; GeoJSON query finds vehicles within 10km radius using geospatial indexing
User views vehicle details, partner rating, pricing, and availability
User selects dates/times, confirms booking request
Razorpay payment with HMAC verification; amount includes platform commission
Partner receives notification, accepts or declines booking
User receives OTP; partner confirms pickup by entering OTP
Socket.IO broadcasts real-time location; user tracks ride on map
Partner enters drop OTP to complete ride; triggers payment settlement
Booking marked complete; commission calculated; earnings updated; user can rate

architecture.description: Rydex uses Next.js 14 with TypeScript for full-stack development, MongoDB with geospatial indexing for vehicle discovery, Socket.IO for real-time features, and integrates services for payments, video KYC, and AI assistance.

keyFeatures.title: Geospatial Vehicle Discovery
keyFeatures.description: MongoDB 2dsphere index enables efficient proximity queries. GeoJSON stores vehicle locations; Leaflet displays results on interactive map. 10km radius search using $near operator.

keyFeatures.title: Eight-Step Partner Onboarding
keyFeatures.description: Progressive workflow guides partners through registration. Each step validates before advancing. ZegoCloud video KYC provides real-time identity verification with admin.

keyFeatures.title: Platform Commission Engine
keyFeatures.description: 10% platform commission calculated on each booking. Earnings split: user payment → platform commission → partner earnings. Real-time calculation and transparent display.

keyFeatures.title: OTP-Based Confirmations
keyFeatures.description: Two-stage verification: pickup OTP confirms ride start; drop OTP confirms completion. Prevents fraud and creates audit trail.

keyFeatures.title: Real-Time Ride Tracking
keyFeatures.description: Socket.IO rooms per ride. Partner app broadcasts location updates; user sees live position on map. Optimized update frequency balances accuracy and performance.

keyFeatures.title: Video KYC Integration
keyFeatures.description: ZegoCloud enables real-time video calls between partner and admin for identity verification. Records verification status and timestamp.

engineeringDecisions.decision: GeoJSON and MongoDB 2dsphere index for vehicle discovery
engineeringDecisions.rationale: Native geospatial support in MongoDB. 2dsphere index enables efficient proximity queries. GeoJSON is standard for geographic data.
engineeringDecisions.tradeoffs: MongoDB geospatial features are powerful but limited compared to PostGIS. For current scale, MongoDB is sufficient.

engineeringDecisions.decision: Multi-step onboarding workflow with state machine
engineeringDecisions.rationale: Complex onboarding requires progressive disclosure and validation. State machine ensures proper sequence and prevents skipping steps.
engineeringDecisions.tradeoffs: More complex than single form, but significantly better UX and data quality.

engineeringDecisions.decision: Platform commission calculated at booking time
engineeringDecisions.rationale: Commission rate might change; calculating and storing at booking prevents historical data issues. Clear separation of user payment, commission, and partner earnings.
engineeringDecisions.tradeoffs: Stored calculations use more space but provide accuracy and audit trail.

engineeringDecisions.rationale: Specialized service handles video infrastructure complexity. Reliable video quality and recording capabilities.
engineeringDecisions.tradeoffs: Third-party dependency and cost; considered building custom but KYC reliability is critical.

engineeringDecisions.decision: Six Mongoose models for data separation
engineeringDecisions.rationale: Clear separation: User, Partner, Vehicle, Booking, Payment, Review. Easier to query and maintain than single combined model.
engineeringDecisions.tradeoffs: More models require more joins; used Mongoose populate for relationships.

engineeringDecisions.decision: OTP at both pickup and drop
engineeringDecisions.rationale: Two-party verification at critical transitions prevents 'ghost rides' and disputed completions.
engineeringDecisions.tradeoffs: Slight UX friction; considered GPS-based completion but OTP is more reliable.

challenges.challenge: Accurate geospatial search across varying locations
challenges.solution: Implemented GeoJSON with proper coordinate order (longitude, latitude). Used 2dsphere index. Tested with various radius values to balance coverage and relevance.

challenges.challenge: Managing complex booking state across multiple actors
challenges.solution: State machine with clear transitions: requested → accepted → pickup_confirmed → in_progress → drop_confirmed → completed. Each transition requires specific actor and event.
Store commission rate, user payment, commission amount, and partner earning at booking time. Display breakdown clearly in partner dashboard.
Save progress at each step; allow partial completion; clear progress indicator; estimated time remaining; skip non-critical steps initially.

lessonsLearned: Geospatial features require careful index configuration and understanding of coordinate systems
Multi-step workflows need clear state management and progress indication
Marketplace platforms require careful balance of user, partner, and platform interests
Commission and earnings calculations should be transparent and auditable
Video KYC adds trust but requires reliable infrastructure
Two-party verification (OTP) significantly reduces disputes and fraud
Real-time features create better UX but add complexity to testing and debugging
